name: Allow + non-scalar condition value (bare object where a scalar belongs)
note: S1-shape-failclosed regression (the audit's exact case). A Condition value that is DIRECTLY a non-scalar - here aws:PrincipalOrgID:{} - is not a primitive scalar nor an array of scalars. AWS rejects it as MalformedPolicyDocument; the engine's value normalizer keeps only scalars, so it models a value set the author did not write. The prior detector inspected only value ARRAYS and skipped a bare-object value (a fail-OPEN). The shared engine must mark coverage INCOMPLETE (MALFORMED_CONDITION_VALUE) so neither surface reports a clean pass.
